data.summary:
AI/ML Computational Science Specialist with 11+ years of experience in IT and
5.5+ years in Data Science, specializing in developing and deploying NLP and traditional ML solutions.
 Proven ability to design, develop, and deploy production-ready applications
based on Natural Language Processing (NLP), including Search Engines, Information Retrieval, Question-Answering bots, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Retrieval Augmented Generative systems (RAG).
 Proficient in cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, and Azure, holding certifications including Google Cloud Certified Cloud Digital Leader Engineer, Microsoft Certified - AI 900, and AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate.
 Experienced in leading and mentoring data science teams, demonstrated by managing a team of 8+ data scientists at Accenture.
 Successfully developed and deployed a scalable hybrid search engine for
enterprise data using Python, FastAPI, Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure DevOps, Docker, and Elastic Search (BM25 + Vector), impacting 3000+ practitioners and saving an average of 120 minutes per week per user.
 Designed and implemented a responsible RAG system with QA, summarization, and language guardrails using Milvus Vector DB, GPT-4o (Azure OpenAI), and guardrails-ai, ensuring 100% English-only output compliance and filtering 98.7% of unsafe outputs.
 Skilled in developing end-to-end pipelines from data acquisition to inference in the cloud, with experience in CI/CD pipelines, release management processes, and security compliances.
 Expertise in various machine learning algorithms, including Linear Models, Decision Trees, Random Forest, KNN, SVM, Boosting Machines, and Neural Networks, along with text processing, clustering, and text mining techniques.
 Proficient in programming languages and tools such as Python, R, SQL, scikit- learn, NumPy, pandas, TensorFlow, Keras, and various vector databases including Milvus, ElasticSearch, Weaviate, Chroma, and Pinecone.
 Replace legacy keyword search with a high-recall, low-latency enterprise search solution enhanced by Generative AI.
Solutions & Responsibilities:
Designed and implemented ETL pipelines to extract and preprocess unstructured data (PDF, PPTX, DOCX, XLSX).
Generated embeddings using OpenAI text-embedding-ada-002 and indexed content in Elastic Search (BM25 + Vector).
Built a unified FastAPI search API, deployed via Azure App Service, with automated refresh pipelines using Azure Functions.
Applied Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) to merge keyword and vector retrieval results, improving relevance.
Integrated GPT-4o (Azure OpenAI) for on-the-fly summarization of top retrieved documents.
Tech Stack: Python, FastAPI, Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Docker, Elastic Search, Azure DevOps, Azure OpenAI.
LLM Techniques: Hybrid Retrieval (Vector + BM25 with RRF), GPT-4o Summarization.
Impact: Saved ~120 minutes/week for 3000+ practitioners, boosted decision-making through GPT-based summaries, and improved Top-5/Top-10 precision vs. traditional search.
SEMANTIC SEARCH ENGINE FOR ENTERPRISE DATA
 Provide a unified semantic search interface for 5000+ intranet web pages from multiple CMS platforms.
Solutions & Responsibilities:
Built content pipelines using enterprise crawler APIs for extraction, preprocessing, tokenization, and embeddings.
Partnered with SMEs to create evaluation datasets and trained labeling teams for relevance improvement.
Established a feedback loop to iteratively enrich metadata, improving retrieval accuracy.
Tech Stack: Python, Enterprise Crawler APIs, Embedding Models, Elastic Search.
Impact: Delivered highly relevant and low-latency semantic search, improving information accessibility across diverse intranet 
domains.
RESPONSIBLE RAG SYSTEM WITH QA, SUMMARIZATION & LANGUAGE GUARDRAILS
 Develop a Responsible AI-powered RAG system for enterprise Q&A and summarization with bias/toxicity safeguards.
Solutions & Responsibilities:
Designed a RAG pipeline using Milvus Vector DB and GPT-4o for contextual enterprise Q&A.
Added GPT-4o summarization for top-ranked documents to enhance accessibility.
Applied guardrails-ai for toxicity, bias, and unsafe content detection.
Enforced English-only outputs and schema validation for structured responses.
Built a modular backend with FastAPI and PostgreSQL for query, feedback, and violation logging.
Tech Stack: Python, FastAPI, Milvus, PostgreSQL, Azure OpenAI, Docker, Azure DevOps, guardrails-ai.
LLM Techniques: RAG with Vector Search + GPT-4o, Guardrails.
Impact: Achieved 100% compliance on English-only outputs, filtered 98.7% unsafe responses, and earned 4.5/5 user satisfaction, fostering trust and adoption.
LLM POWERED FEATURES TO ENTERPRISE SEARCH ENGINE
 Enhance enterprise search engines with Generative AI-driven features for better knowledge access.
Solutions & Responsibilities:
Integrated ChatGPT Turbo (Azure OpenAI) for summarizing crawled documents and web pages.
Implemented RAG-based “Ask a Question” feature for contextual responses.
Embedded and stored content in Elastic Search Vector Store for efficient retrieval. Tech Stack: Python, Elastic Search Vector Store, Azure OpenAI (ChatGPT Turbo). LLM Techniques: RAG + Summarization.
Impact: Improved content accessibility and enabled contextual enterprise Q&A, increasing knowledge discovery.
FEDERATED LEARNING ANALYSIS IN BIOMEDICAL APPLICATIONS
 Explore federated learning frameworks for secure biomedical image analysis.
Solutions & Responsibilities:
Analyzed existing federated learning frameworks for distributed medical imaging.
Incorporated deep learning models into privacy-preserving frameworks.
Optimized models for compliance with healthcare privacy and regulatory standards.
Tech Stack: Python, TensorFlow/PyTorch, Federated Learning Frameworks.
Impact: Advanced privacy-preserving medical image analysis workflows, aligning with compliance needs.
MACHINE LEARNING APPLICATION FOR PREDICTING CONTINGENCIES IN VERIZON DATA SERVICE INSTALLATIONS
 Predict and mitigate service installation issues for Verizon data services.
Solutions & Responsibilities:
Engineered ML applications to forecast installation contingencies.
Addressed imbalanced datasets using SMOTE sampling.
Trained and optimized Random Forest model for accuracy.
Tech Stack: Python, Scikit-learn, SMOTE, Random Forest.
Impact: Reduced misclassification rate to 79%, improving the prediction and resolution of installation issues, ensuring timely service completion.
INTELLIGENT CATEGORIZATION OF TICKETS
 Automate ticket categorization for faster issue resolution.
Solutions & Responsibilities:
Processed ticket data with embeddings and tokenization.
Trained a DNN model to classify categories.
Conducted 6-month evaluation to monitor category prediction accuracy.
Tech Stack: Python, DNN, Embeddings, NLP.
Impact: Enhanced ticket routing efficiency and improved support team productivity.
AGENTIC INSIGHT GENERATOR FOR CLIENT EARNINGS TRANSCRIPTS
 Automate insight generation from client earnings call transcripts to support strategic decisions.
Solutions & Responsibilities:
Designed a multi-agent RAG pipeline using GPT-4o for theme extraction (Growth, Cost, Sustainability).
Generated ThemeBriefs, categorizations, and validating facts with citations.
Retrieved enterprise case studies/solutions via Milvus Vector DB for contextual recommendations.
Applied Guardrails-AI for schema enforcement, English-only outputs, and fact validation.
Automated client communication by generating insights emails and PowerPoint decks.
Tech Stack: Python, FastAPI, GPT-4o, Milvus, Haystack, CrewAI, guardrails-ai, PostgreSQL, python-pptx.
LLM Techniques: Multi-agent RAG, Guardrails.
Impact: Reduced analyst effort by 90%, scaled insights across 50+ enterprise clients, and increased solution pitch conversion by 25%.
